what: Client logo tiles (120×75 · corner 16) are set evenly on three concentric rings (radius 17.78·32.78·47.78vw, 8·16·20 tiles) with each tile’s long side standing along the circumference, and from when the Section enters the bottom edge of the screen until it leaves the top edge, each ring rotates 180°·-135°·90° with no easing curve — inner and outer rings turn in opposite directions, wrapping the single center line (trust statement). Under 1200px two rings (29.04·49.04vw), under 767px 215·365px

options.turn: Angle each ring turns during the pass (degrees, comma-separated — negative for the opposite direction), default 180,-135,90 · 0 means that ring stands still
options.start · end: Range it runs over (ScrollTrigger), default top bottom · bottom top
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Original tile (logo) placed right below the panel — hidden, then cloned in turn and placed on the ring

note: Panel height and the top/bottom blur (a background-color gradient mask) are supplied by the caller. The original is 650px high with the top 20% and bottom 20% blurred into the background color. The original pulled tiles out at random, while this part pulls them out in a fixed order per ring (same picture every time it opens)

from.where: shared.js ring logo ([data-orbit] in index.html and about.html — original .is--circleanimation rings 8·16·20, rotationAmount 180·135·90, direction 1·-1·1)
